messages:
maria: Heads-up: Thorpoint escalated to P1 — they're seeing ~30% 503s on their Dedicated pool for the last 10m. Customer impact: checkout failures and timeouts. Need immediate ownership, short-term workaround, and ETA for fix. @sam @lee @jordan

sam: On it. Quick hypothesis: KV-cache eviction thrash after the model variant rollout last night. I see spike in cache misses and downstream timeouts. Can someone pin any related deploys/rollouts in the last 2 hours?

jordan: I can take routing adjustments. Suggest temporary route Thorpoint -> hosted-us-east-2 (lower latency for them) while we stabilize Dedicated. Requires a small routing-conf PR and a token refresh (auth team). If agreed I'll open the PR and list steps.

deploy-bot: [automated] canary-deploy: model-variant v2.3 completed at 1759012200. No errors reported by pipeline.

lee: I'll own rollback if that's the chosen short-term fix. Plan: 1) pause traffic to pool A, 2) rollback model-variant to v2.2 on pool A, 3) monitor p95/p99 for 20m. ETA ~28m for rollback + validation. PR: https://git.company/repo/rollbacks/PR-459 (open).

ria: Quick Q — routing to hosted will increase token costs and slightly higher median latency. Are we OK with that short-term tradeoff from CS? Also, can we rate-limit noisy clients from Thorpoint to avoid thundering?

sam: Log snippet from the Dedicated pool (last 60s):
```
[2026-03-18T12:07:21Z] WARN kv_cache: eviction_count=1245 miss_rate=0.62
[2026-03-18T12:07:23Z] ERROR request_handler: downstream_timeout id=abcd1234 latency=3100ms
[2026-03-18T12:07:24Z] ERROR model_infer: oom_fallback=false alloc_failed=true
```
This lines up with eviction thrash -> increased inference latency -> upstream timeouts.

maria: Action items (recap):
- Lee: rollback ownership + link PR (lee) — in progress, ETA ~28m.
- Jordan: routing PR to hosted-us-east-2 as fallback (jordan) — please include runbook steps and token checklist.
- Sam: continue logs/tracing and confirm if cache sizing tweak would help short term.
- Ria: coordinate with CS on cost/latency tradeoffs and temporary rate limits; update customer.
- All: please update ticket INF-1421 with progress + timestamps.

lee: Rolling back now — I'll post status updates.

jordan: Opening routing PR now and pinging auth for token refresh. PR: https://git.company/repo/routing/PR-778

ria: Noted, I'll message CS and propose hosted fallback + brief note about costs.

sam: If rollback doesn't reduce eviction we may need quick cache size bump + restart of the runtime on pool A; prepping a patch.

maria: Thank you — keep this thread updated. If any blocker emerges escalate to the oncall bridge.

lee: Rollback completed at 1759012400. Early metrics: error rate down from 30% -> 9% in first 3m. Continuing validation.

maria: Great. Next check-in in 15m unless things change.
